headline: 10 verdicts delivered by HC in women, children repression cases in one month
summary: The High Court has fast-tracked justice for victims of violence and abuse, resolving a significant number of cases in a short period.
details: The High Court of Bangladesh has delivered 10 verdicts in cases involving the repression of women and children within a single month.
These verdicts come as part of a broader effort to clear case backlogs and ensure timely justice for vulnerable groups.
The court's focus on these specific types of cases highlights the urgency of addressing gender-based violence and child abuse in the legal system.
The proceedings were conducted to ensure that victims and their families receive legal closure and that perpetrators are held accountable.
caption:
10 verdicts in 30 days. The High Court is speeding up justice for women and children.

The High Court of Bangladesh has delivered 10 verdicts in cases involving the repression of women and children within a single month.

These verdicts come as part of a broader effort to clear case backlogs and ensure timely justice for vulnerable groups.

The court's focus on these specific types of cases highlights the urgency of addressing gender-based violence and child abuse in the legal system.

The proceedings were conducted to ensure that victims and their families receive legal closure and that perpetrators are held accountable.

headline_marked: Home Minister [[BNP will always stand by people]] during disasters
headline: Home Minister BNP will always stand by people during disasters
summary: Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed spoke at an event in Cox's Bazar where household items were distributed to 100 flood-affected families.
details: Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed stated that the BNP's politics is for the country and its people, as it is a government elected by the people.
Speaking at an event organized by the Alhaj Shamsul Huq Foundation in Pekua, Cox's Bazar, he distributed household items to 100 families who became homeless due to floods.
The Minister emphasized a policy formulated by Tarique Rahman: 'Bangladesh first and people before power,' stating that the party views its role as a responsibility rather than just power.
He announced plans to support farmers whose crops, seedbeds, and seedlings were destroyed by the floods, providing agricultural inputs such as fertilizer, seeds, and pesticides.
Salahuddin Ahmed further committed to standing by the poor and ensuring justice for the people of the country.
He also mentioned that the current budget is people-friendly and poor-friendly, aimed at preventing any increase in the price of essential commodities.
caption:
“Bangladesh first and people before power.” Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed reaffirms BNP's commitment to disaster relief.

Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed stated that the BNP's politics is for the country and its people, as it is a government elected by the people.

Speaking at an event organized by the Alhaj Shamsul Huq Foundation in Pekua, Cox's Bazar, he distributed household items to 100 families who became homeless due to floods.

The Minister emphasized a policy formulated by Tarique Rahman: 'Bangladesh first and people before power,' stating that the party views its role as a responsibility rather than just power.

He announced plans to support farmers whose crops, seedbeds, and seedlings were destroyed by the floods, providing agricultural inputs such as fertilizer, seeds, and pesticides.

Salahuddin Ahmed further committed to standing by the poor and ensuring justice for the people of the country.

He also mentioned that the current budget is people-friendly and poor-friendly, aimed at preventing any increase in the price of essential commodities.

#Bangladesh #BNP #CoxsBazar #FloodRelief #Politics #SalahuddinAhmed

Source: Jamuna TV
